lead.en: The same application answers as JSON over REST, describes itself as an OpenAPI document, and speaks GraphQL on one of its own routes. None of the three is written twice.
lead.zh: 同一个应用，用 REST 回 JSON、用 OpenAPI 文档描述自己、又在自己的一条路由上说 GraphQL。这三样没有一处是写两遍的。

foot.zh: 第 04 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: Every route call carries a `summary`; `App::describe` carries the title and the version. The document is assembled from those at the moment it is read.
text.zh: 每条路由调用都带一个 `summary`；`App::describe` 带标题和版本。文档在读取的那一刻由这些拼出来。

text.en: There is no OpenAPI file in this repository. A route added in an exercise appears here with no edit, and a route deleted leaves no stale line behind.
text.zh: 本仓库没有 OpenAPI 文件。练习里加的一条路由会自己出现在这里，删掉的路由也不会留下过期的一行。

text.en: `/openapi.json` and `/docs` are published by the application itself, and `/docs` is a page that reads the document the app serves. Neither is listed in the document, which is why the reader pages are not paths in it.
text.zh: `/openapi.json` 与 `/docs` 由应用自己发布，`/docs` 是一个读应用所发文档的页面。两者都不列在文档里 —— 所以文档中没有阅读器这两条路径。

title.en: What the document does not describe

text.en: The GraphQL route appears as a path, but its schema is not translated into OpenAPI. GraphQL describes itself through introspection, on the same URL, which is the point of mounting it on a route rather than beside one.
text.zh: GraphQL 那条路由作为路径出现，但它的 schema 不会翻译成 OpenAPI。GraphQL 在同一个 URL 上通过内省描述自己 —— 这也正是把它挂在路由上、而不是放在路由旁边的意义。

text.en: The schema is a value, the resolvers are another, and the handler is mounted as an ordinary route — so GraphQL rides the same transport and the same middleware as every JSON endpoint.
text.zh: schema 是一个值，resolvers 是另一个值，处理函数作为普通路由挂上去 —— 于是 GraphQL 和每个 JSON 端点走同一套传输、同一套中间件。

text.en: An unknown field is not a `400`: the query failed but the transport succeeded, so the answer is `200` with an `errors` document. A request without a JSON content type fails before the query is parsed, and that is `415`.
text.zh: 未知字段不是 `400`：查询失败了，但传输成功了，所以答案是 `200` 加一份 `errors` 文档。不带 JSON content type 的请求在解析查询之前就失败，那是 `415`。

items.en: Add a field `shout(name: String!): String!` that upper-cases the greeting. Fetch `/openapi.json` afterwards and find which of the two surfaces learned about it.
items.zh: 加一个 `shout(name: String!): String!` 字段，把问候变成大写。之后取 `/openapi.json`，看看两个门面里哪一个知道了它的存在。

items.en: Ask for `{ greeting }` without the argument. The schema says `String!`, so the answer is an error document — read the message before you fix the query.
items.zh: 请求 `{ greeting }` 但不给参数。schema 写的是 `String!`，所以回来的是一份错误文档 —— 先读那条消息，再改查询。

items.en: Change `App::describe`'s title and re-read the document. Nothing else in the repository mentions the title; find the one place it is written.
items.zh: 改掉 `App::describe` 的标题再看文档。仓库里没有别处提到这个标题 —— 找出它被写下的那一处。

items.en: Fetch an OpenAPI document from a running service and read a path out of it.
items.zh: 从运行中的服务取一份 OpenAPI 文档，并读出其中一条路径。

items.en: Explain why the document needs no separate file.
items.zh: 解释文档为什么不需要另存一份文件。

items.en: Mount a GraphQL schema on an existing application and call it with curl.
items.zh: 把 GraphQL schema 挂到已有应用上，并用 curl 调用。

items.en: Tell a `415` from an `errors` document, and say which layer decided each.
items.zh: 分清 `415` 与 `errors` 文档，并说出各自是哪一层决定的。
